comment: Reviewed dependency allow-list for writ-hostsys (hostsys/DEPENDENCIES.md; M5a-03, D-045; M5-DEPENDENCY-REVIEW section 2). The closure covers normal and build dependencies; the workspace path dependency writ-kernel is gated by its own allow-list. rustix 1.1.6 with features std, fs, process only (default features off); no package that is not already in Cargo.lock and approved for writ-broker. 'Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT' is approved for rustix 1.1.6 and linux-raw-sys 0.12.1 only (owner decision 2026-11-12), not as a general licence.

rustix.role: direct runtime (safe openat2 with resolve flags, statx mount id, statfs, renameat_with RENAME_NOREPLACE, lgetxattr ACL detection; getuid, getgid, kill_process_group, test_kill_process); default features off, features std, fs, process; released 2026-10-27; licence approved for this package only (owner decision 2026-11-12), used under its MIT option
rustix.licence_approved: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

linux-raw-sys.role: transitive (rustix linux_raw backend on Linux; features auxvec, elf, errno, general, ioctl, no_std, prctl); released 2025-12-23; licence approved for this package only (owner decision 2026-11-12), used under its MIT option
linux-raw-sys.licence_approved: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

bitflags.role: transitive (rustix; feature std through rustix std); same version as approved for writ-broker and writ-ledger-sqlite; released 2026-09-10

errno.role: transitive, target-specific (rustix libc backend: non-Linux Unix targets, the rustix_use_libc cfg, and Windows); not compiled on x86_64 Linux; released 2025-09-09

libc.role: transitive, target-specific (rustix and errno libc backend targets); not compiled on x86_64 Linux; same version as approved for writ-kernel and writ-broker

windows-sys.role: transitive, Windows targets only (rustix, errno); not compiled on Linux; released 2025-10-06

windows-link.role: transitive, Windows targets only (windows-sys); not compiled on Linux; released 2025-10-06
